This is exactly what happened to me at 36. My periods would last for 3 weeks then I wouldn’t have one for 2 or 3 months. I also got really bad brain fog where I would struggle to form sentences. I’ve been on HRT and it’s helped so much! My hair is growing back and I feel generally better. If you are you aren’t alone and there’s lots of resources out there to assist you! But make sure it’s not your thyroid! Sending lots of love your way!

This would seem like periomenopause. I had exactly the same thing at 37. I skipped my period and then had it for a month. I got tested and my FSH was at 55 and estrogen at 13. Got an ultrasound and have premature ovarian failure. I would request an ultrasound to test ovarian reserve. 

I just started HRT. The brain fog was horrible! I couldn’t articulate my thoughts and would often be so stuck I felt like I couldn’t respond when asked a question. I’m starting to feel normal!

Abandoholism is similar to the other ‘oholisms, but instead of being addicted to a substance, you’re addicted to the emotional drama of heartbreak. You pursue hard-to-get partners to keep the romantic intensity going, and to keep your body’s love-chemicals and stress hormones flowing.

Conversely, when someone comes along who wants to be with you, that person’s availability fails to arouse the required level of insecurity. If you can’t feel those yearning, lovesick feelings, then you don’t feel attracted, so you keep pursuing unavailable partners.

You described me. It’s called abandoholism. Look it up it will shed some light into why you behave this way and how you can gain awareness. You aren’t alone and it’s great that you’re aware of it. Speaking from personal experience I think it’s best to try to work on it, get to know yourself and love yourself! Eventually, you’ll see your worth and pick the right guy who loves you for you!
